title: Tomotope Bacon-Shor Packet Code

packet_code.layout: 4 chart rows x 4 columns where columns = 2 orientations x 2 chiralities

toroidal_tomotope_context.packet_factorization: 16=4 chart rows x (2 orientations x 2 chiralities) columns
toroidal_tomotope_context.toroidal_hint: CLXIV uses H(n)=((n-3)(n-4))/12 with accepted residues {3,4,7,12}; the 4 is the tetrahedral seed and the 12 denominator is 3x4.

architecture_upgrade: Constructs the explicit 16-slot tomotope/chirality packet as a 4x4 Bacon-Shor subsystem code. The packet is [[16,1,4]], and 81 copies give a native [[1296,81,4]] packet layer; replacing W33 line-star logical components gives a target lower bound [[1296,81,>=12]].
theorem: A 4x4 Bacon-Shor subsystem code has 16 physical slots, one protected logical degree, 9 gauge qubits, stabilizer-center rank 6, and distance 4. Interpreting rows as tetrahedral chart vertices and columns as orientation x chirality realizes the tomotope packet factorization 16=4x(2x2).
honesty_boundary: This constructs the local 16-slot packet and its independent 81-packet layer. The final integrated W33-to-packet attachment map and full global subsystem distance still need a dedicated compiler.
